svg.text: Wire colours: red 5 V, orange 3.3 V, black GND, brown battery after the switch, magenta servo power, blue SDA, yellow SCL, teal display (SPI), violet audio (I2S), green other GPIO.
The ESP32-S3 headers are drawn in the board's real order (Freenove / DevKitC layout, antenna up); Oreo's pins are bold. A dot joins wires; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
Left unconnected: display TE, amp GAIN and SD, PCA9685 OE, MPU6050 XDA/XCL/AD0/INT, ToF GPIO1/XSHUT. Mic L/R goes to GND (left channel).
everything that lives in the head
power, servo board, IMU, OLED, servos
8.4 V, 2 A: GND pad = battery -, BAT pad = battery +
5 V up the neck to the S3's 5V pin
I2C: servo board 0x40, OLED 0x3C, MPU6050 0x68 (ToF 0x29 is in the head)
Default channels - change them on the robot's Servo mapping page (/servomap) if yours are wired differently.
